risk_summary: The excerpt is generally promotional and optimistic, emphasizing market leadership, growth opportunities, acquisitions, and product capabilities. It includes useful quantitative disclosure on divestitures, segment profitability, margins, tariffs, and discontinued operations, but relies on boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and broad claims regarding competitive position and future growth. Divestitures, integration and acquisition execution, tariff liabilities, and reliance on favorable market conditions remain notable risk areas.
